spans.s: सम—भाग m. an equal share, MW.
सम—भाग mfn. (prob.) receiving an equal share, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 1, Sch.
सम—भाव m. equability, homogeneousness, Bhām.; HPariś.
सम—भाव mfn. of like nature or property, W.
सम—भूमि f. even ground (˚मि-तले, ‘on ev˚ gr˚’), R.
सम—भूमि ind. (prob.) = -म्-भूमि॑ (below) g. तिष्ठद्-गु.
सम्-अभि-√ कीर्त् (only ind.p. -कीर्त्य), to relate or tell fully, narrate, MBh.
सम्-अभि-√ क्रम् (only ind.p. -क्रम्य), to go near to, approach, MBh.
greatly enraged, angry, MBh.

सम्-अभि-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go towards together, approach, R.;
to go to, have sexual intercourse with (instr.), Kathās.
सम्-अभि-√ गर्ज् P. -गर्जति, to shout or cry at defiantly, challenge with a shout (acc.), MBh.
सम्-अभि-√ गुह् Ā. -गूहते, to crouch down, cower, Hariv.
completely covered with (instr.), MBh.
सम्-अभि-√ जन् Ā. -जायते, to spring up together, arise, R.
(only ind.p. -ज्ञाय), to recognize fully, entirely acknowledge or perceive, MBh.
सम्-अभि-√ तर्ज् P. -तर्जयति, to threaten or menace greatly, abuse, blame, scold, Hariv.
towards, to (acc.), MBh.
सम्-अभि-√ त्यज् P. -त्यजति, to give up entirely, wholly renounce or resign, MBh.
wholly given up, renounced, risked, MBh.
सम्-अभित्यक्त—जीवित mfn. one who has quite renounced his life, Hariv.
सम्-अभि-√ द्रु P. -द्रवति (ep. also Ā. ˚ते), to run or hasten towards or against, rush full upon, attack, assail (acc.), Nir.; MBh. &c.
running towards or against, rushing upon, MBh.
rushed upon, attacked, infested, ib.
(अम्), ind. hurriedly, quickly, ib.
a name, appellation, Inscr.
addressed, spoken to, BhP.
सम्-अभि-√ धाव् P. Ā. -धावति, ˚ते, to run hastily up to or towards, fly or dart at, assail, MBh.; R.

सम्-अभि-√ ध्यै P. -ध्यायति, or -ध्याति, to reflect deeply on, meditate on MBh.;
to direct all the thoughts upon, long for (acc.), Suśr.

सम्-अभि-√ नन्द् P. -नन्दति, to rejoice together with (see next);
to greet, salute, R.; Kathās.
rejoiced with, congratulated, Kathās.
come forth, gushed forth (as blood from a wound), MBh.
सम्-अभि-√ पत् P. -पतति, to fall upon, attack (acc.), R.
सम्-अभि-√ पाल् P. -पालयति, to protect, rule, govern (acc.), Hariv.
सम्-अभि-√ पीड् P. -पीडयति, to squeeze together, crush, Hariv.
सम्-अभि-√ पूज् P. -पूजयति, to worship, honour, MBh.
सम्-अभि-√ पॄ Caus. -पूरयति, to till up, fill, MBh.
(-प्र-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. -प्रेक्षते, to look at, perceive, view, R.

सम्-अभि-√ प्लु Ā. -प्लवते, to inundate, wash (see next);
to overwhelm, cover, MBh.; R.
inundated, flooded, washed, R.
overwhelmed, covered, MBh.
eclipsed (as the moon), R.
(with रजसा) covered with menstrual excretions, Mn. iv, 42.
सम्-अभि-√ भाष् Ā. -भाषते (ep. also P. ˚ति), to speak with or to, address (acc.), MBh.
conversation, colloquy with (instr. or comp.), R.
सम्-अभि-√ या P. -याति, to approach any one (acc.) together, go towards or near, advance, MBh.; Hariv.; MārkP.
सम्-अभि-√ याच् P. Ā. -याचति, ˚ते, to ask earnestly, implore, Hariv.
सम्-अभि-√ रञ्ज् Ā. or Pass. -रज्यते, to be reddened, appeared, flash, glitter, MBh.

सम्-अभि-√ रुह् P. -रोहति, to grow up together, ascend, Hariv. (v.l. सम्-अधि-र्˚) :
Caus. -रोहयति (Pass. -रोप्यते), to cause to grow up or ascend, place or impose on (as a burden &c.), ib.
सम्-अभि-√ लष् P. -लषति, to long for, be eager for, Hariv.
सम्-अभि-√ वद् Caus. -वादयति, to address or salute respectfully, MBh.; Hariv.
सम्-अभि-√ वध् (defective; see √ वध्), to strike or hit at any one (acc.), MBh.
सम्-अभि-√ वाञ्छ् P. -वाञ्छति, to long for, be eager for, VarBṛS.
(-वि-√ ईक्ष्) P. -वीक्षते, to perceive, become aware of (acc.), Śak. (v.l.)

सम्-अभि-√ वृध् Ā. -वर्धते, to grow up, increase, Hariv. :
Caus. -वर्धयति, to make larger, enlarge, increase, augment, MBh.; R.
सम्-अभि-√ वृष् P. -वर्षति to rain down upon, BhP.

सम्-अभि-व्य्-आ-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to mention together, Nyāyam.;
to bring together, associate together, MW.
mentioning together, KātyŚr.
bringing together, association, company, Kaṇ.
association with a word of well-known meaning (= प्रसिद्धार्थकस्य शब्दस्य संनिधिः), MW.
सम्-˚अभिव्याहारिन् mfn. mentioning together, ib.
accompanying, ib.
सम्˚अभिव्याहृत mfn. mentioned or spoken of together, Kusum.
associated (= सहित), accompanied by, MW.
सम्-अभि-√ शुभ् Ā. -शोभते, to be beautiful or shine with (instr.), R.
thoroughly coagulated, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 1, 26.

P. -षिञ्चति, to sprinkle down upon, wet, Hariv.;
to anoint, consecrate, Kathās.
P. Ā. -ष्टौति, -ष्टुते, to praise highly, extol, MBh.; R.
extolled, celebrated, BhP.
P. -तिष्ठति, to mount upon (as upon an elephant), MBh.
, Caus. -ष्यन्दयति to cause to flow towards (acc.), Car.
causing hypertrophy, Car.
entirely surrounded, encompassed, MBh.

सम्-अभि-सं-√ धा cl. 1. P. Ā. -दधाति, -धत्ते, to place or put into (loc.), MBh.;
to aim at, strive after, determine on (acc.), ib.
सम्-अभि-√ सृ P. -सरति (ind.p. -सृत्य), to go towards, approach, advance, attack, MW.
the act of going towards or against, approaching, seeking, wishing or endeavouring to gain, ib.

सम्-अभि-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to seize upon or take together, MW.;
to seize, take, take out, ib.
the act of seizing upon, taking &c., ib.
repetition, Pat. on Pāṇ. iii, 1, 22.
सम्-˚अभिहार m. seizing or taking together, MW.
repetition, reiteration (क्रिया-समभिहारेण, ‘by a repetition of acts’, ‘by repeated acts’), Pāṇ.; Śiś.
excess, surplus, W.
सम्-अभि-√ हृष् Caus. -हर्षयति, to cause great joy or exultation, gladden, delight, MBh.
सम्-अभ्य्-अति-√ क्रम् P. -क्रामति, to come upon or into, enter into, R.
सम्-अभ्य्-√ अर्च् P. -अर्चति, to pay great honour to, worship, greet, salute (acc.), Yājñ.; MBh.
the act of paying great honour to, worshipping, reverencing, W.
सम्-˚अभ्यर्चित mfn. greatly honoured, worshipped, saluted, ib.
सम्-अभ्य्-√ अर्थ् Ā. -अर्थयते, to petition, solicit, request, MW.
seeking, petitioning, a petitioner, Kum.
सम्-अभ्य्-अव-√ गा P. -जिगाति, to go into (acc.), GopBr.

(-अव- √ 5. इ) P. -अवैति, to penetrate entirely into (acc.), ŚBr.;
to come to an agreement with (instr.), ib.
सम्-अभ्य्-√ अस् P. -अस्यति, to practise, exercise, Subh.
practice, exercise, study, KāśīKh.
nearness, presence, MBh.

सम्-अभ्य्-आ-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to come near (see next);
to meet, Prasannar.
come near, approached, Pañcat.

सम्-अभ्य्-आ-√ गा P. -जिगाति, to come near, approach, MBh.;
to come upon, seize, visit (with affliction), ib.
सम्-अभ्य्-आ-√ 1. दा Ā. -दत्ते, to comprehend, ŚBr.
सम्-अभ्य्-आ-√ नी P. -नयति, to lead near or towards, introduce, MBh.
bringing near, Pat. on Pāṇ. ii, 1, 51.
bringing together, association, accompaniment, MW.
heaping, piling up (-वत् ind.), ĀpŚr.
सम्-अभ्युच्चय—वत् ind.
Ā. -तिष्ठते, to rise (said of a planet), Hariv.
सम्-अभ्य्-उद्-√ गम् (only ind.p. -गम्य), to come forth or spread from (abl.), Divyāv.

Ā. -धरते, to draw out, extract, Sarasv.;
to draw out of danger or distress, rescue, raise, promote further, MBh.
drawing out, rescuing, MBh.
striving, endeavouring, Divyāv.
raised, risen, towering high (as clouds), Mṛcch.
the act of approaching or going near, MW.
following, approving, agreeing with, RPrāt., Sch.
(-उप- √ 5. इ) P. उपैति, to go very near, approach, MW.
to be gone or approached or followed, ib.
= सम्-अभ्युपगमन, RPrāt., Sch.
(-आ- √ 5. इ) P. -ऐति, to come up to, approach, go near to (acc.), MBh.; Pañcat.
सम्-आ-√ भा P. -भाति, to appear like (इव), MBh.

सम्-आ-√ भाष् Ā. -भाषते, to talk with, converse together, address, speak to, MBh.; R.; BhP.;
to speak about, communicate, MBh.
talking together, conversation with (comp.), Ragh.
सम्-आ-√ भुज् P. -भुनक्ति, to enjoy or possess entirely, rule over (acc.), BhP.
सम्-आ-√ भृ P. -भरति, or -बिभर्ति, to bring together, produce, procure, TS.
brought together, procured, AV.
साम—भृ॑त् mfn. bringing chants, RV.
